source_note: Rates and thresholds as amended by the Finance Act 2025 (in force from 1 April 2025). Legacy section numbers are from the Income-tax Act 1961. From 1 April 2026 these provisions sit in the TDS table of the Income-tax Act 2025; the new-Act references below must be confirmed by the tax owner, and so must any change made by the Finance Act 2026. Nothing in this file is decided by the model.
no_pan_rule: Section 206AA: if the payee has not furnished a PAN, deduct at the higher of the normal rate, twice the normal rate, or 20%.

contract_work.label: Contract work (labour, repairs, housekeeping, security, advertising, catering, carriage of passengers)

goods_transport.label: Carriage of goods by road (freight to a transporter)

professional_service.label: Professional services (legal, medical, engineering, architecture, accountancy, technical consultancy, interior decoration)
professional_service.act_2025_ref: s.393 table - fees for professional services (verify)

technical_service.label: Fees for technical services (managerial, technical or consultancy services that are not a 'profession')
technical_service.act_2025_ref: s.393 table - fees for technical services (verify)

rent_land_building.label: Rent for land, building, furniture or fittings (includes hotel rooms taken on a regular basis)

rent_plant_machinery.label: Rent / hire of plant, machinery or equipment

goods_purchase.label: Purchase of goods (no service element)
goods_purchase.note: Not covered by 194C/194J/194I/194H. Section 194Q (purchase of goods above Rs 50 lakh by large buyers) is out of scope of this prototype.
